#  Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the notes.

---

## Common Infrastructure

All shaders in this chapter use the same boilerplate from previous chapters: ray generation, orbit camera, gradient-based normals, raymarching. Each shader is self-contained — paste it into Shadertoy and it runs.

The key evolution from previous chapters is the `shade` function, which grows to include specular highlights, shadows, ambient occlusion, fog, and gamma correction — each one adding a term from the rendering equation.

---

## specular

Blinn-Phong specular highlights. The shade function takes a DirLight struct and computes diffuse + specular using the halfway vector.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    vec3 ambient = mat * 0.15;
    return ambient + (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        DirLight sun = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));
        color = shade(normal, material, viewDir, sun);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## soft-shadows

Soft shadow penumbra. The shadow march tracks the closest-approach ratio d/t, approximating the fraction of an extended light source visible from each point.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.62, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p - vec3(0.0, 0.5, 0.0), 0.8);
    float box = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5), vec3(0.5));
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(min(sphere, box), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    if (sdBox(p - vec3(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5), vec3(0.5)) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.6, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shadows ---

float softShadow(vec3 p, vec3 lightDir, float k) {
    float res = 1.0;
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        res = min(res, k * d / t);
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return res;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    float sh = softShadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir, 16.0);
    return (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color * sh;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        DirLight sun = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.5)), vec3(1.0));
        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, sun);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## improved-soft-shadows

Improved soft shadow penumbra using the circle-fitting technique. Tracks the previous step's SDF sample to estimate true closest-approach distance, reducing artifacts where rays pass through narrow gaps.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.62, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p - vec3(0.0, 0.5, 0.0), 0.8);
    float box = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5), vec3(0.5));
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(min(sphere, box), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    if (sdBox(p - vec3(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5), vec3(0.5)) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.6, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shadows ---

float softShadow(vec3 p, vec3 lightDir, float k) {
    float res = 1.0;
    float t = 0.02;
    float prev = 1e20;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;

        float y = d * d / (2.0 * prev);
        float h = sqrt(d * d - y * y);
        res = min(res, k * h / max(0.0, t - y));

        prev = d;
        t += d;

        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return res;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    float sh = softShadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir, 16.0);
    return (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color * sh;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        DirLight sun = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.5)), vec3(1.0));
        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, sun);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## ambient-occlusion

Split-screen ambient occlusion comparison. Left half: no AO. Right half: with AO darkening corners and crevices. The AO function samples the SDF along the normal as a cheap quadrature of the hemispherical visibility integral. The 0.3/0.7 ambient/direct split gives ambient a larger share than the other demos, making the AO effect clearly visible.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    float box = sdBox(p - vec3(1.8, -0.25, 0.0), vec3(0.75));
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(min(sphere, box), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    if (sdBox(p - vec3(1.8, -0.25, 0.0), vec3(0.75)) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.4, 0.7);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Ambient Occlusion ---

float ambientOcclusion(vec3 p, vec3 n) {
    float ao = 0.0;
    float scale = 1.0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        float dist = 0.02 * float(i);
        float d = sdScene(p + n * dist);
        ao += (dist - d) * scale;
        scale *= 0.5;
    }

    return 1.0 - clamp(ao, 0.0, 1.0);
}

// --- Shading ---

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        float ao = ambientOcclusion(p, normal);

        vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(normal, h)), 32.0);
        vec3 lit = material * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;

        // 0.3/0.7 split: boost ambient share so AO darkening is visible
        if (fragCoord.x > iResolution.x * 0.5) {
            color = material * 0.3 * ao + lit * 0.7;  // Right: with AO
        } else {
            color = material * 0.3 + lit * 0.7;        // Left: without AO
        }
    }

    // Dividing line
    if (abs(fragCoord.x - iResolution.x * 0.5) < 1.0) {
        color = vec3(1.0);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## fog

Distance fog fading objects into the atmosphere. Repeated columns recede into exponential fog (Beer's law).

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.55, 0.52);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    // Grid of columns via domain repetition
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(q.xz + 2.5, 5.0) - 2.5;
    float column = sdBox(q, vec3(0.4, 1.5, 0.4));

    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(column, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.25);
    return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.4);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 10.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 fogColor = vec3(0.5, 0.6, 0.7);
    vec3 color = fogColor;

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.5));
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
        color = material * 0.15 + material * diff;

        // Exponential fog (Beer's law)
        float fog = 1.0 - exp(-t * 0.05);
        color = mix(color, fogColor, fog);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## height-fog

Height-dependent fog that pools in valleys and thins at elevation. Fog density falls off exponentially with height; the integral along the view ray has a closed form.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.55, 0.52);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(q.xz + 2.5, 5.0) - 2.5;
    float column = sdBox(q, vec3(0.4, 1.5, 0.4));

    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.5);
    return min(column, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.5) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.25);
    return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.4);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Fog ---

float heightFog(vec3 rayOrigin, vec3 rayDir, float t) {
    float sigma0 = 0.15;
    float beta = 0.8;
    float dy = rayDir.y;

    if (abs(dy) < 0.001) {
        return sigma0 * exp(-beta * rayOrigin.y) * t;
    }

    float startDensity = exp(-beta * rayOrigin.y);
    float endDensity = exp(-beta * (rayOrigin.y + t * dy));
    return sigma0 / (beta * dy) * (startDensity - endDensity);
}

// --- Shading ---

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 10.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 fogColor = vec3(0.5, 0.6, 0.7);
    vec3 color = fogColor;

    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.5));
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
        color = material * 0.15 + material * diff;

        // Height fog (Beer's law with exponential density falloff)
        float fog = 1.0 - exp(-heightFog(ray.origin, ray.dir, t));
        color = mix(color, fogColor, fog);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## point-lights

Directional key light (steady sun) plus a warm point light orbiting the scene. The two structs — `DirLight` and `PtLight` — make the difference explicit: directional lights have a direction, point lights have a position, and the shading functions handle each accordingly.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

struct PtLight {
    vec3 pos;
    vec3 color;
    float intensity;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p - vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0);
    float box = sdBox(p - vec3(1.5, -0.5, 0.0), vec3(0.5));
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(min(sphere, box), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    if (sdBox(p - vec3(1.5, -0.5, 0.0), vec3(0.5)) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.5, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.3, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shadows ---

float softShadow(vec3 p, vec3 lightDir, float k, float maxDist) {
    float res = 1.0;
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        res = min(res, k * d / t);
        t += d;
        if (t > maxDist) break;
    }

    return res;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    float sh = softShadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir, 16.0, 20.0);
    return (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color * sh;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, PtLight light) {
    vec3 toLight = light.pos - p;
    float dist = length(toLight);
    vec3 lDir = toLight / dist;
    float atten = light.intensity / (1.0 + dist * dist);

    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, lDir));
    vec3 h = normalize(lDir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    float sh = softShadow(p + n * 0.01, lDir, 16.0, dist);
    return (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color * atten * sh;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.08;

        // Directional key light (the sun)
        DirLight sun = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.5)), vec3(0.5, 0.45, 0.4));

        // Orbiting point light
        float angle = iTime * 0.8;
        vec3 lp = vec3(2.5 * cos(angle), 1.5, 2.5 * sin(angle));
        PtLight orb = PtLight(lp, vec3(1.0, 0.7, 0.3), 6.0);

        color = ambient
              + shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, sun)
              + shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, orb);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## complete

Full lighting pipeline: specular, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, fog, two-light setup, and gamma correction.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p - vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0);
    float box = sdBox(p - vec3(1.5, -0.5, 0.0), vec3(0.5));
    float torus = sdTorus(p - vec3(0.0, 0.3, -1.5), 0.6, 0.2);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(min(min(sphere, box), torus), ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    if (sdSphere(p - vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2);
    if (sdTorus(p - vec3(0.0, 0.3, -1.5), 0.6, 0.2) < eps) return vec3(0.2, 0.7, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.3, 0.4, 0.8);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shadows ---

float softShadow(vec3 p, vec3 lightDir, float k) {
    float res = 1.0;
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        res = min(res, k * d / t);
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return res;
}

// --- Ambient Occlusion ---

float ambientOcclusion(vec3 p, vec3 n) {
    float ao = 0.0;
    float scale = 1.0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        float dist = 0.02 * float(i);
        float d = sdScene(p + n * dist);
        ao += (dist - d) * scale;
        scale *= 0.5;
    }

    return 1.0 - clamp(ao, 0.0, 1.0);
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    float sh = softShadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir, 16.0);
    return (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color * sh;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 8.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.5, 0.6, 0.7);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        // Ambient occlusion
        float ao = ambientOcclusion(p, normal);

        // Ambient light
        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15 * ao;

        // Key light: warm, from upper right
        DirLight key = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0, 0.9, 0.8));
        vec3 keyContrib = shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, key);

        // Fill light: cool, from the left
        DirLight fill = DirLight(normalize(vec3(-1.0, 0.3, 0.0)), vec3(0.15, 0.2, 0.3));
        vec3 fillContrib = shade(p, normal, material, viewDir, fill);

        color = ambient + keyContrib + fillContrib;

        // Fog
        vec3 fogColor = vec3(0.5, 0.6, 0.7);
        float fog = 1.0 - exp(-t * 0.04);
        color = mix(color, fogColor, fog);
    }

    // Gamma correction
    color = pow(color, vec3(1.0 / 2.2));
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```


## gamma

Split-screen gamma correction comparison. Left half: no gamma correction (linear values sent straight to the display, which applies its own gamma curve — midtones appear too dark). Right half: gamma corrected. Compare the midtones.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct DirLight {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

// --- Camera ---

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);
        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shade(vec3 n, vec3 mat, vec3 v, DirLight light) {
    float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
    vec3 h = normalize(light.dir + v);
    float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, h)), 32.0);

    vec3 ambient = mat * 0.15;
    return ambient + (mat * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec) * light.color;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        vec3 viewDir = -ray.dir;

        DirLight sun = DirLight(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));
        color = shade(normal, material, viewDir, sun);
    }

    // Right half: gamma corrected. Left half: linear (uncorrected).
    if (fragCoord.x > iResolution.x * 0.5) {
        color = pow(color, vec3(1.0 / 2.2));
    }

    // Dividing line
    if (abs(fragCoord.x - iResolution.x * 0.5) < 1.0) {
        color = vec3(1.0);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
